notes.title: Update Version 1.2.2
notes.notes:
Update Information (Ver. 1.2.2)
・The master volume not functioning normally during loading was corrected.
・The letterboxing function was added as an option.
・It was made so that the resolution is matched in full screen at startup only during the initial startup.

notes.title: Update Version 1.2.1
notes.notes:
Updates
- Added FPS Lock to the options menu. (WIP)
- Added a startup method that resets the game's Key Config.
  [-ResetSettings] options.
- Fixed a Key Config bug that allowed for duplicate key/button mapping.
- Added support for displaying keyboard controls when a controller is plugged in.
